profile.belief: I’ve always had a passion for photography and have always been curious as to how movies were made. One day I tried videography and quickly realized how much more emotion and meaning can be conveyed through moving images versus still photographs. From that moment on, I wanted to learn everything I could about filmmaking. I’ve worked on every set I can, and I am addicted to the energy of being on set, and bringing stories to life behind the camera.
profile.working_on: The ultimate goal for me is to establish myself as a cinematographer. I want to create visuals that make audiences feel emotions that are difficult to put into words. Beyond that, I want to build a community of hardworking individuals who create for the love of the art not just for recognition.
